messages:
Maya: Heads up — outstanding action items from the PM-321 postmortem are overdue. Can owners please confirm status/ETAs? Listing: ACTION-1 (Sam) - infra alert routing; ACTION-2 (Anya) - KV cache repair; ACTION-3 (Leo) - canary rollback automation. Please reply by EOD Fri or we'll reassign.
Sam: @Maya saw. Infra routing is blocked by a firewall rule change sitting in review. Patch is tested, just needs infra review. ETA Mon 03/30. Assigning @Nora for the review.
Anya: KV cache repair needs more logs — I asked for sample traces in the PM thread but haven't gotten them. Can someone attach the trace dump? cc @Maya
Leo: Canary rollback automation is ~50% done. PR: https://github.com/redwood/ops/pull/412. Hoping to finish testing today but low priority because dedicated capacity rollout is blocking. ETA Tue.
Nora: On it, Sam. I'll review the patch Tue morning. If this blocks customer flows we should escalate. :+1:
Sam: If review slips I'll reassign to infra oncall — we shouldn't let this drag two weeks.
InfraBot: Reminder: JIRA-5678 created for 'infra routing fix' — linked to PM-321. Assignee: Sam. Due: 2026-04-06.
Maya: Thanks. @Anya — here's the trace dump: https://storage.internal/redwood/pm321/trace-dump-03-24.log. Also @Sam if you can confirm whether the short-term workaround (disable prefix caching) is acceptable we'll proceed after review.
Anya: Got the trace, thanks. I can triage today but will need temporary key rotation if we disable caching (security check). Risk: small perf hit. ETA for patch: today EOD.
Sam: Workaround approved by me for now. @Maya can we schedule a rollback window later today? Ops oncall availability 17:00-19:00 PT.
Maya: Scheduling 17:30 PT. @Leo please prepare canary rollback playbook and post link here.
Leo: Will do. Pushing PR now. :hammer_and_wrench:
Maya: Using this thread to track. Please update here when steps are complete. I'll mark action items updated in the postmortem doc.
Leo: Rollback tested in staging, ready for window. PR merged. Logs look clean.
Nora: Reviewed Sam's patch — small nit, merged. Infra routing fix deployed to canary.
InfraBot: Deploy bot: canary deploy completed for infra-routing-fix at 1786049000.
Sam: Canary looks good. Rolling to prod now.
InfraBot: Deploy bot: prod deploy completed for infra-routing-fix at 1786051200.
Anya: KV cache repair rolled with temporary key rotation. Monitoring looks stable so far.
Maya: Thanks all. @Sam @Anya @Leo @Nora please confirm final status by EOD so I can close the items in the PM.
Sam: Confirmed fixed.
Anya: Confirmed.
Leo: Confirmed.
Nora: Confirmed and added notes to the PM doc (https://docs.internal/redwood/postmortems/PM-321).
Maya: Closing here — I'll update the postmortem with remediation timestamps and mark items closed. :white_check_mark:
